# accordion

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/component/accordion"
```

Package accordion is a column of sections, each a heading that opens and closes the body under it, sliding rather than jumping.

<a name="Model.Advance"></a>
### func \(Model\) [Advance](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/accordion/accordion.go#L151>)

```go
func (m Model) Advance(now time.Time) (Model, bool)
```

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/component/accordion/accordion.go#L74-L78>)

Styles are how an accordion paints its headings and bodies.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Cursor  lipgloss.Style // the heading under the cursor
    Heading lipgloss.Style // every other heading
    Body    lipgloss.Style // the open part of a section
}
```

DefaultStyles paint the cursor in the cursor role, headings bold and bodies dim.
